description:
The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was initiated on 1st April 2021. 

The primary objective of the Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is to promote livestock farming in the state. 

The scheme aims to enhance the income of livestock farmers by providing them with financial assistance. 

It also seeks to improve the quality of livestock and increase milk production in Madhya Pradesh. 

The government has set a target to increase the milk production in the state by 20% over the next five years. 

The scheme is designed to benefit small and marginal farmers who are engaged in livestock rearing. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a subsidy of 50% on the purchase of high-quality livestock. 

Farmers can receive a maximum subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for purchasing livestock. 

The scheme also includes financial assistance for the construction of cattle sheds. 

Farmers can receive a subsidy of 40% for constructing cattle sheds with a maximum limit of ₹1 lakh. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana also promotes the use of modern technology in livestock farming. 

Farmers can avail of training programs organized by the government to learn about modern livestock management practices. 

The scheme encourages the establishment of dairy cooperatives to enhance milk production and marketing. 

The government aims to establish at least 100 new dairy cooperatives under this scheme within the next three years. 

Eligibility for the Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is primarily focused on small and marginal farmers. 

Farmers must own a minimum of 2 acres of agricultural land to qualify for the benefits. 

The annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹2 lakh to be eligible for the scheme. 

The scheme is open to both men and women farmers. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for the scheme. 

The application process for the Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested farmers must visit the nearest Krishi Vikas Kendra to obtain the application form. 

They must fill out the application form with accurate details and submit it along with the required documents. 

Required documents include proof of land ownership, income certificate, and identity proof. 

Farmers must also provide a quotation for the livestock or cattle shed they intend to purchase or construct. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

Upon successful verification, the subsidy amount will be credited to the farmer's bank account. 

The government aims to disburse the subsidy within 30 days of the application approval. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying in Madhya Pradesh. 

Farmers can contact the department for any queries or assistance regarding the scheme. 

The contact details for the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying are available on the official government website. 

The scheme has seen a positive response since its launch. 

As of October 2023, over 10,000 farmers have benefited from the scheme. 

The total amount disbursed under the scheme has exceeded ₹50 crores. 

The government is continuously working to improve the scheme based on feedback from beneficiaries. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is part of the broader initiative to boost the agricultural economy in Madhya Pradesh. 

The state government is committed to enhancing the livelihood of farmers through various welfare schemes. 

Livestock farming plays a crucial role in the rural economy of Madhya Pradesh. 

The state has a significant population of cattle and buffaloes, contributing to the dairy sector. 

The government aims to leverage this potential through targeted support and incentives. 

The scheme also focuses on promoting indigenous breeds of livestock. 

Farmers are encouraged to rear local breeds that are better adapted to the local climate and conditions. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is aligned with the National Livestock Mission. 

This national initiative aims to enhance livestock production and productivity across India. 

The Madhya Pradesh government is also collaborating with various NGOs and organizations to implement the scheme effectively. 

Awareness campaigns are being conducted to inform farmers about the benefits of the scheme. 

The government is utilizing digital platforms to reach a wider audience. 

Farmers can access information about the scheme through the official government portal. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is a significant step towards sustainable livestock farming. 

It aims to empower farmers and improve their economic conditions. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in the rural economy by increasing employment opportunities. 

The government is optimistic about achieving its targets for milk production and livestock quality. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is a testament to the government's commitment to the agricultural sector. 

The scheme reflects the need for modernizing livestock farming practices in Madhya Pradesh. 

Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of this scheme to improve their livelihoods. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the progress of the scheme regularly. 

This ensures that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries effectively. 

The Mukhyamantri Pragatishil Pashupalak Protsahan Yojana is a vital initiative for the development of the livestock sector in Madhya Pradesh. 

It aims to create a sustainable and profitable livestock farming environment for farmers in the state.
